newsitem.title: CHINA: China's largest sugar refining group established.
newsitem.headline: China's largest sugar refining group established.

text.p: China has established its largest sugar-refining group in the southwestern Guangxi region, with capacity to produce 230,000 tonnes of sugar a year, state media said on Friday.

Nanning Unified Sugar-Refining Co Ltd, recently listed as one of 300 large enterprises that receive major state support, was formed by grouping six state-owned sugar-making enterprises in the regional capital, Nanning, the Xinhua Daily Telegraph said.
The group has registered capital of 499 million yuan and 708 million yuan of fixed assets. It will mainly engage in sugar refining and production of sugar-refining machines.
The conglomerate is able to press 2.02 million tonnes of sugarcane and to produce 230,000 tonnes of sugar annually. Its sugar output accounts for 10 percent of the regional total.
The group generated 948 million yuan of industrial output value and reported 107 million yuan of pre-tax profits in 1996. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
